request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:KNIGHT

layers.text: Change only the colours: the red cape becomes near-black charcoal with a thin bright violet trim along its scalloped edge and a deep violet lining on its inside; the red coat becomes near-black charcoal with pale ivory bone buttons; his skin becomes very pale ash grey with no blue; his eyes glow bright violet and every blue flame becomes bright violet. Keep the shirt, hair, fangs, rapier,pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
